An update is available for thunderbird.
This update affects Rocky Linux 8.
A Common Vulnerability Scoring System (CVSS) base score, which gives a detailed severity rating, is available for each vulnerability from the CVE list
notes.title: Topic

notes.text:
Mozilla Thunderbird is a standalone mail and newsgroup client.

Security Fix(es):

* firefox: thunderbird: Sandbox escape due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics component (CVE-2026-92035)

* firefox: thunderbird: Use-after-free in the Graphics: Canvas2D component (CVE-2026-100832)

* firefox: Use-after-free in the Layout: Text and Fonts component (CVE-2026-100784)

* firefox: thunderbird: Privilege escalation due to incorrect boundary conditions in the Graphics component (CVE-2026-100782)

* firefox: firefox: Sandbox escape via use-after-free in DOM component (CVE-2026-100811)
